links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of LLM answers to choroidal melanoma patient medical advice questions
links.effect: For medical advice questions, ChatGPT gave 92% accurate responses compared to 58% for Bing AI and DocsGPT; pre/post-op accuracy 86% (ChatGPT, Bing AI) and 73% (DocsGPT); no statistically significant differences between models.
links.quote: For medical advice questions, ChatGPT gave 92% accurate responses compared to 58% for Bing AI and DocsGPT.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of responses from three LLMs (ChatGPT 3.5, Bing AI, DocsGPT) to common patient questions regarding choroidal melanoma; evaluated by expert reviewers without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
